original_ai_output.title_zh: 南非东海岸发生鲨鱼袭击事件，65岁游泳者身亡
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 南非东海岸KuGompo City（原东伦敦）一处海滩发生鲨鱼袭击，65岁的Janine Lochrenberg在晨泳时被咬伤身亡。目击者称她大腿和上臂两处被咬，被同伴救上岸前已死亡。当局已关闭事发海滩及附近另一处海滩。这是南非今年首起有记录的鲨鱼致死事件。

location.raw_text: Orient Beach, KuGompo City (formerly East London), South Africa's east coast

key_facts.fact: 65岁女子Janine Lochrenberg在南非东海岸KuGompo City一处海滩晨泳时遭鲨鱼袭击身亡
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Janine Lochrenberg was swimming off a beach in KuGompo City (formerly East London) on Tuesday morning when she was attacked.

key_facts.fact: 目击者称她大腿和上臂两处被咬，被同伴带上岸前已死亡
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Witnesses said the 65-year-old was bitten in two places and died before she was brought to shore.

key_facts.fact: 当局已关闭事发海滩Orient Beach及附近另一处海滩
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Orient Beach, where the attack took place, has been closed alongside another nearby beach, authorities confirmed.
